# RepChime

RepChime is an iPhone fitness utility that combines a configurable HIIT timer with automatic repetition counting.

Official website: https://repchime.app/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1441675623
Terms of Service: https://repchime.app/legals/term-of-service/
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://repchime.app/legals/privacy/

## Main capabilities

- HIIT intervals with Work, Rest, Prepare, multiple rounds, and sound countdowns.
- Automatic repetition counting with iPhone motion sensors and a front-camera mode for push-ups.
- Saved Timer and Counter presets.
- Ladder progression for time or repetition goals.
- Optional spoken guidance, timer recovery after returning to the app, scheduled phase notifications, and other RepChime Pro features.

## Supported exercises

Push-ups, sit-ups, pull-ups, and squats.

## Languages on this website

English, German, French, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
